data.action: 趴在浴缸边，指尖戳着泡泡
data.camera: side view, medium shot, horizontal framing
data.description: 装满丰富泡沫的宽大浴缸里，能天使整个人趴在浴缸沿旁，指尖欢快地戳破一个又一个飞起的七彩肥皂泡。白皙滑腻的香肩在水雾中泛着红晕——「老板快来看！这个泡泡吹得超级大！……一个人洗澡好无聊啊，要不要进来和我一起打水仗？」
data.promptProse: She rests against the tub rim and reaches up with one fingertip to pop a floating soap bubble, her other forearm supported on the rim. Warm bathroom light shines through the bubbles and steam.
data.title: 能天使 · 泡泡浴
data.animaCaption: One forearm rests on the rim while a fingertip of her other hand reaches for a floating bubble.
